note: the note is signed Ch. in English, Challoner, and C. in Portuguese, Calmet
the lemma 'And on' became 'E assim por diante', which reads as et cetera rather than as the words being commented on
an English article survived inside the Portuguese, 'do the exercito'
'they have not left off, in order to be converted' became 'nao deixaram de converter-se', which says they never stopped converting
'though determined on his destruction' became 'ainda que resolvido a destrui-la', which makes Christ the destroyer instead of Jerusalem
